newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks dip in morning after firmer start.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks dip in morning after firmer start.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks dipped in Wednesday morning trade, shedding their initial gains despite a rise in HSBC Holdings Plc shares as the interest rate outlook kept investors cautious, analysts said.
The Hang Seng Index was down 46.11 points, or 0.34 percent, at 13,403.97 after rising to an early high of 13,498.64.
Turnover was HK$1.74 billion after the first half hour of trade.
"Property stocks seeem to be a little sluggish and basically I think the market is continuing to discount an interest rate rise," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities.
Shares in HSBC Holdings rose HK$1.50 to HK$188.00 after shedding HK$2.50 on Tuesday.
But Hang Seng Bank continued its decline, falling HK$0.50 to HK$84.25 after a drop of HK$4.25 on Tuesday.

"For the time being, investors are still staying at the sidelines," said Edward Chan, head of research at Amsteel Securities. He said the market was awaiting the second phase of U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony due later on Wednesday.
The first phase of his testimony, delivered last week, sent local share prices tumbling last Friday.
With interest rates once again a focus, analysts said investors were also keeping to the sidelines ahead of key U.S. February jobs data due on Friday.
Analysts said the performance of the market over the coming weeks would depend on the response to upcoming property sales.

The property sector was weak on Wednesday with Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd down HK$1.00 at HK$74.75, Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd off HK$1.00 at HK$90.75 and Henderson Land Development Co Ltd down HK$0.50 at HK$70.50.
Man Yue International Holdings Ltd made its market debut on Wednesday at HK$1.20, compared with an issue price of HK$1.08.
The stock later extended its gains to trade at HK$1.27. The company makes electronic components.
Shares in Hongkong Telecom pushed ahead despite the weak tone in the overall market. The stock was up HK$0.20 at HK$13.95.
